title: How Should LLMs Consume High-Quality Data? Optimal Data Scheduling via Quality-Aware Functional Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2605.25698v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-quality data is scarce in large language model (LLM) training, yet how to schedule its use with optimization dynamics lacks theoretical guidance. We extend functional scaling laws with time-varying data quality and derive asymptotically optimal joint data-quality and batch-size schedules within a feature-space regression model. The solution reveals two regimes and dual uses of high-quality data: in the noise-limited regime, a smaller batch converts cleaner data into more signal at comparable noise; in the signal-limited regime, late placement suppresses terminal noise without sacrificing signal accumulation. This explains why conventional decay schedules can conflict with curriculum-style pipelines. Motivated by the theoretical structure, we propose Drop-Stable-Rampup for LLM midtraining: drop the batch size at the quality transition, keep it low to accumulate signal, then ramp up to suppress noise. translated_title: 大语言模型应如何消费高质量数据？通过质量感知功能缩放定律实现最优数据调度
translated_abstract: 高质量数据在大语言模型（LLM）训练中十分稀缺，但如何结合优化动态来调度其使用缺乏理论指导。我们扩展了具有时变数据质量的功能缩放定律，并在特征空间回归模型中推导出渐近最优的联合数据质量和批量大小调度方案。该解决方案揭示了两种机制和高质量数据的双重用途：在噪声受限机制中，较小的批量将更干净的数据转化为更强的信号，同时保持相当的噪声水平；在信号受限机制中，后期放置可抑制终端噪声而不牺牲信号积累。这解释了传统衰减调度为何可能与课程式流水线冲突。受理论结构启发，我们提出了用于LLM中期训练的Drop-Stable-Rampup方法：在质量转换时降低批量大小，保持低批量以积累信号，然后逐步增加以抑制噪声。在15B MoE模型中期训练中，该方法展现出显著效果。
tldr: 本文通过质量感知功能缩放定律，提出最优数据调度策略（Drop-Stable-Rampup），揭示了高质量数据在噪声受限和信号受限两种机制下的双重用途，并解释了传统衰减调度与课程式流水线的冲突。
en_tdlr: This paper derives optimal data scheduling via quality-aware functional scaling laws, proposing Drop-Stable-Rampup for LLM midtraining, which reveals dual roles of high-quality data and resolves conflicts between decay schedules and curriculum pipelines.
